label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Sale of Goods Directive ((EU) 2019/771) - Article 14: Repair or replacement of the goods
1. Repairs or replacements shall be carried out:
(a) free of charge;
(b) within a reasonable period of time from the moment the seller has been informed by the consumer about the lack of conformity; and
(c) without any significant inconvenience to the consumer, taking into account the nature of the goods and the purpose for which the consumer required the goods.
raw_output: When a customer reports a product defect, the seller must repair or replace the item free of charge, within a reasonable time, and without causing significant inconvenience to the customer. This applies during the after-sales service step, involving the customer and the seller.
enrichment: When a customer reports a product defect, the seller must repair or replace the item free of charge, within a reasonable time, and without causing significant inconvenience to the customer. This applies during the after-sales service step, involving the customer and the seller.
